title: Morphogen card, version 1
description: What a change is for, what it may touch, and what it must hold to. The author writes it; the judge checks it against the policy on the protected base, which it can only make stricter. It names held-out cases by reference and never carries them.

intent.description: One sentence a person can check against the diff.

scope.description: Repository-relative glob patterns for the paths the change may add, modify or delete. '*' matches within one path segment, '**' across segments.

cases.description: A reference to a held-out case set the base's policy lists. Never the cases.

must_pass.description: Case ids (or id prefixes ending in '*') the candidate must get right.

must_not_change.description: Case ids (or id prefixes ending in '*') where the candidate's output must equal the base's.

network.description: Hosts the untrusted run may reach. Empty or absent means no network. Each must be allowed by the policy.

source.description: Who measures it. 'scorer': the trusted job scores the candidate's outputs against held-out answers. 'runner': the harness outside the candidate's container (wall time, CPU, memory). 'meter': the model gateway's record. There is no value for numbers the candidate reports.

floor.description: For a deciding KPI: the smallest mean per-case improvement over the base, in the KPI's own units, that counts (>= 0). For a bounding KPI: the largest mean per-case worsening tolerated (>= 0).
